description: A `type` alias covers only its type expression: the words after it on its line are E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT (one per line), never silently dropped; the code line after them still compiles.
rationale: §40.8 S441 coverage bullet (round 5): a statement covers only the tokens it compiles, measured by its own grammar. Round 4 credited the whole line to the type declaration, and `extra` vanished.
